title: What a patch release may change in the descriptor
lead: The versioning policy is silent on patch releases, but 'Known limits' implies patches fix other defects and so change descriptor bytes for the same input. State what a patch may and may not change (bytes of the descriptor for the same input; `schemaVersion`; `fingerprint.version`) and test the sentence.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Owner decision on whether a patch may change descriptor bytes; 2. policy text and docs test; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
